node.description: Id of exactly one development {node}, or the {node} of a deployment backup (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); the backup must have been taken there

backupRef.description: The backupRef (audit id) from the result of import_artifacts, restore_backup, set_active or deploy_release (per {node})

reason.description: Why; becomes the check-in comment of the new versions and is audited (no # or @)

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview of the first call; executes the restore
